excludedSources.reason: Anokolisa Pixel Crawler forbids repository/template redistribution (d12).
CC-BY-SA / attribution-locked sprite sheets excluded when full CC0 coverage exists (d12).
Entries listed in crawl/tiles TILES_UNDER_UNKNOWN_LICENSE.md are strictly excluded (d12).
Returns HTTP 403 to headless fetch scripts; use verified GitHub CC0 mirrors instead (d10, d11).
